scope: A complete introductory undergraduate linear algebra course from algebraic vector foundations through systems, spaces, transformations, determinants, eigenvalues, orthogonality, least squares, quadratic forms, SVD, and representative applications.
target_learner: A motivated learner with secondary-school algebra fluency who wants an independent first course.
coverage_rationale: The order moves from operations and equations to structural language, maps, geometry, spectral structure, and applications. It preserves the v1.9 evidence-backed vector-space slice while expanding the course around common introductory university coverage.
known_limitations: The course is Japanese-first and English labels are provided for navigation.
Video binaries and large PDFs are build artifacts; tracked video pilots remain source packages.
Pedagogy judgments are recorded as audit findings rather than objective learner guarantees.
